questions.question: When the apostle Paul suffered for the church, how did he say he felt about his sufferings?

answers.text: He was worn out by them

questions.question: God made the apostle Paul a servant of the church. What was his commission from God?

answers.text: To fully proclaim the word of God
To set up elders in every town

questions.question: Paul wrote that a mystery was hidden for ages and is now made known to God's people. What is it?

answers.text: Christ in you the hope of glory
The law within you the lamp of truth
A kingdom restored to the sons of Israel

questions.question: How many of the treasures of wisdom and knowledge did Paul say are hidden in Christ?
